description: Totals and subtotals. Three kinds of case; Bill shape and defaults are in README.md. kind 'payDayPage' (the PayDay home page for the current period): input { kind, anchor, now, bills: [Bill], payments: [ { billId, periodKey, amountPaid } ] }. The current period is 'This Pay Period' from pay-periods; its bills come from bill-assignment. Auto-pay bills go to autoPayBills and ignore payments. A manual bill is paid when a payment exists with its billId and periodKey = the current period key; with several, only the first in input order counts. expected { periodKey, totalDue (sum of manual bills' payment), totalPaid (sum of counted amountPaid), remaining (max(0, totalDue - totalPaid)), progressFraction (totalDue > 0 ? min(1, totalPaid / totalDue) : 0), isAllPaid (no unpaid manual bills and (at least one paid or totalDue == 0)), autoPayTotal, autoPayBills: [id], unpaidBills: [id], paidBills: [ { id, amountPaid } ] }; each list in bill-assignment order. kind 'dashboard': input { kind, anchor, now, bills }. expected { totalMonthlyObligations (active bills: Monthly payment, Bi-Weekly payment*26/12, Yearly payment/12, anything else 0), totalRemaining (sum of active bills' remaining), hasCreditCards (an active bill with type exactly 'Cards' and creditLimit > 0 exists), creditUtilizationPct (those cards' remaining / their creditLimit * 100, rounded to 1 decimal, 0 when hasCreditCards is false), billsDueThisPeriod, sections: [ { label, key, manualTotal, autoPayTotal, grandTotal, billCount, manualBills: [id], autoPayBills: [id] } ] } with one section per period. kind 'billGroups' (All Bills page): input { kind, bills }. Bills are grouped by type (exact, case-sensitive); groups are ordered Cards, Bills, Loans, Installments, Subscriptions, Business, People, Medical, Other, then any other type ordered case-insensitively. Within a group bills are ordered by name, case-insensitive, ties in input order. expected { totalBills, groups: [ { type, count (including inactive), totalPayment and totalRemaining (active bills only), bills: [id] } ] }.
